{"id":"01a1068e-9672-79d1-a6ef-c4a56faade8a","type":"hazard","summary":"Email provider: sandbox behaviour and limits","content":"The notifier sends through the email provider's HTTP API (provider.send). Production credentials exist only in the deployed function's environment. For development there is a separate sandbox account whose key is in the dev secrets store; export it as MAIL_API_KEY. The sandbox has the same API and response shapes, but it is rate-limited to 2 messages per second and capped at 500 messages a day for the whole team, so do not loop over large fixtures. Bounces and complaints are simulated with magic addresses from the provider's docs. Important: the sandbox silently drops (answers 202, never delivers) every message whose recipient is not on the `@sink.acme.test` domain, so a test that asserts delivery must send to an address such as `receipts@sink.acme.test` and read it back from the sink inbox API.","physical":["services/notifier/"],"logical":["notifier"],"tags":["notifier","email","testing"],"criticality":0.5,"confidence":0.8,"status":"active","visibility":"shared","provenance":"human","epistemic":"fact"}

=== README.md # notifier Sends transactional email (receipts, payment reminders) for ledgerline. It is deployed separately from the billing app, as its own function. - `notifier/` - the service code - `migrations/` - the outbox table schema - `tests/` - unit tests === pyproject.toml [project] name = "ledgerline-notifier" version = "0.3.0" requires-python = ">=3.12" dependencies = ["requests>=2.32"] [project.optional-dependencies] dev = ["pytest>=8.0"] === notifier/__init__.py === notifier/email.py from .provider import send from .render import render def send_receipt(invoice_id, to_addr, total_minor): body = render("receipt", invoice_id=invoice_id, total_minor=total_minor) return send(to_addr, "Your receipt", body) def send_payment_reminder(invoice_id, to_addr): body = render("payment_reminder", invoice_id=invoice_id) return send(to_addr, "Payment reminder", body) === notifier/provider.py import os import requests API_URL = "https://api.mailprovider.example/v3/messages" def send(to_addr, subject, body): resp = requests.post( API_URL, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['MAIL_API_KEY']}"}, json={"to": to_addr, "subject": subject, "html": body}, timeout=10, ) resp.raise_for_status() return resp.json()["id"] === notifier/render.py def render(template_name, **context): """Render an email body from a named template.""" raise NotImplementedError === tests/__init__.py === tests/test_email.py from unittest import mock from notifier import email def test_send_receipt_uses_receipt_template(): with mock.patch.object(email, "render", return_value="

[project]
name = "ledgerline"
version = "2026.9.1"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = ["flask>=3.0", "structlog>=24.1", "requests>=2.32"]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["."]
testpaths = ["tests"]
markers = [
    "postgres: needs the database from `docker compose up db`",
    "integration: talks to the payments sandbox over the network",
]
.PHONY: test test-fast

test-fast:
	python -m pytest -m "not postgres and not integration" -q

test:
	python -m pytest -q
import pytest
import requests
